captures.note: The first three records of the JSON endpoint jobgether's own robots.txt explicitly allows (Allow: /astroapi/ai/jobs.json). It carries title, company, url, location, contract type and salary range - which is what the 410'd category pages were being scraped for. Input for the repair, not a repair. The first record's company, Pearl Meyer, is a US executive-compensation consulting firm (pearlmeyer.com), not an individual - checked, because a company name that reads like a person's is exactly what the leakage gate cannot see.
Every one of the five category URLs at src/adapters/jobgether.ts:6-12 answers HTTP 410 Gone. The body is the site's search page, whose canonical link names the replacement.
